sourceReview.reason: A new retry still found only reports repeating the same Blockworks-attributed figures. The dated RWA.xyz view now shows 842,967 Solana RWA holders and does not expose the October 19-to-25 historical series needed to verify the claimed 1.7 million total, six-day increase or category breakdown.
